## Mathematica

If you are a JGU employee, you can activate the ZDV license for mathematica by:

1. Installing Wolfram from this [page](https://reference.wolfram.com/language/tutorial/InstallingWolfram.html)

2. After the download is complete, open Wolfram for the first time, it should ask you to activate the product.

3. Click `Other ways to activate` and select `Connect to a Network License Server`.

4. Enter `mathlm-cl1.zdv.uni-mainz.de` as the server name.

5. That's it, derive away!
